'''0.24c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that changed the seven day reward to not reset if a day is missed and increased the effectiveness of high-tier shotguns.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Now the reward for three wins in a series of seven days is not reset if you missed a day or were not able to win three times
* As a prize for performing three wins in a series of seven days, reward may not only be premium currency, but also rare decals, camo, premium account, etc.
* Increased speed of aiming for the sniper weapon
* Increased cost of stamina when wearing heavy equipment
* Reduced time for dostavaniya / dump all weapons

===Fringe Settlers===
* [[RPK-74M]]: Moved from level 9 to 8;
* [[Benelli M4 Super 90]]: Damage increased to 120, rate of fire increased to 280

===Renaissance Army===
* [[Franchi SPAS 12]]: Damage increased to 120, rate of fire increased to 240

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed bug occurring when running the game on Windows Vista
* Fixed some bugs that affect stability of the servers
